text.content:
Part of the Middens' collapse continues here - a section of wall has come down entirely, revealing older stonework behind it: precise, mortared, nothing like the goblins' own rough digging. A faded mural survives on the exposed stone, showing figures herding pack animals up a switchback trail toward a stable-yard gate.

GM Notes

Breather: No threat. Pure lore.

Subquest/lore - What This Place Was: This warren wasn't dug by goblins - it was a way-station stable-yard, built solidly enough that the goblins simply moved into the shell of it generations later. This ties directly to Old Tam's journal (see the Entrance, Room 0, and the Boss Arena, Room 28): he's the last person who kept this place properly, and everything the goblins have built since - the pens, the Larders, the throne - is scaffolding grown over his abandoned stable-yard.
